# Travel and Expense Policy (Test Document)

Share with: **the whole organization**.

## 1. Before you travel

- Every work trip needs your **manager's approval before booking**.
- Trips that cost more than **Rs 25,000** in total also need the **Admin's approval**.
- Book through the company travel desk when possible.

## 2. How to travel

- Trains: AC 2-tier.
- Flights: economy class, and only when the train journey is longer than **8 hours**.
- Using your own car: reimbursed at **Rs 12 per km**.

## 3. Hotels

| City type | Maximum per night |
|---|---|
| Metro cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad) | **Rs 4,500** |
| All other cities | **Rs 3,000** |

## 4. Daily allowance

- Meals and local travel are covered up to **Rs 2,000 per day** on approved trips (same as the Employee Handbook).

## 5. Claiming money back

- Submit receipts **within 30 days** of the trip.

# Employee Handbook (Test Document)

This handbook applies to everyone in the **Employee** role. Share it with the Employee role, so Employees and every role above them can read it.

## 1. Working hours

- Core hours are **10:00 to 16:00**, Monday to Friday. Outside core hours, employees choose their own start and end time.
- A full working week is **40 hours**.

## 2. Leave

| Type of leave | Days per year | How to apply |

1. Application screen by HR (within **5 working days** of applying).

4. Final interview with the Admin.

- Day 1: laptop handed over (see the IT Security Policy), MFA set up.
- Day 1: invite the person to Trellis from **Admin → Members** with their role; the manager adds them to their team.
- Assign an onboarding **buddy** from the same team for the first month.
